subject: chaos_knight_phantasm
definition: 制造自身或他人的幻象
evidence: When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.
When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a %bonus_illusion_chance%%% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.
施放混沌之军时，会产生全地图上所有友方英雄的一个幻象。
混沌骑士产生幻象时都会有%bonus_illusion_chance%%%几率额外产生一个在其控制下的幻象。

context.description_en:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal %outgoing_damage_tooltip%%% damage, but take %incoming_damage_tooltip%%% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
context.description_zh:
从其他维度召唤若干个混沌骑士的幻象。幻象继承%outgoing_damage_tooltip%%%攻击力，但是承受%incoming_damage_tooltip%%%伤害。
驱散类型：弱驱散
notes_en: Removes most negative buffs from Chaos Knight.
Chaos Knight is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.
notes_zh: 能够移除混沌骑士的大部分负面状态。
混沌骑士在施放时有%invuln_duration%秒的无敌时间，可以躲避眩晕和伤害技能。

scepter_loc.en: Gains a passive component.  When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a %bonus_illusion_chance%%% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.
scepter_loc.zh: 增加被动效果。混沌骑士产生幻象时都会有%bonus_illusion_chance%%%几率额外产生一个在其控制下的幻象。施放混沌之军时，会产生全地图上所有友方英雄的一个幻象。

subject: dark_seer_wall_of_replica
definition: 制造自身或他人的幻象
evidence: 每堵光墙同一时间产生的为一名英雄产生的幻象只有一个。

context.description_en: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.
context.description_zh: 制造一堵扭曲的光墙，对穿过的敌方英雄造成伤害和减速，并复制一个其自身的幻象，幻象由黑暗贤者控制，持续到光墙消失，或者被敌人消灭。
notes_en: Doesn't create illusions from other illusions.
There cannot be more than one illusion per player per wall.
notes_zh: 幻象不会产生幻象。
每堵光墙同一时间产生的为一名英雄产生的幻象只有一个。

subject: grimstroke_dark_portrait
definition: 制造自身或他人的幻象
evidence: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero.
制造目标敌方英雄的墨色幻象。

context.description_en: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.
context.description_zh: 制造目标敌方英雄的墨色幻象。幻象为减益免疫状态，拥有%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性，移动速度和继承攻击力超过本体。

subject: morphling_replicate
definition: 制造自身或他人的幻象
evidence: 开启后会产生目标英雄的强幻象，可以施放英雄的所有基础技能。

context.description_en: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
context.description_zh: 使自身向敌方目标改变，获得其基础技能，并且基于目标改变自己的主属性。技能持续时间内可以来回切换。
notes_en: You can't target yourself with Morph.
Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
notes_zh: 变体精灵自身及其控制的单位不能作为变形的目标。
变形不会复制魔晶/神杖类技能，除非变体精灵自身也拥有相应物品。
不会触发法术反弹。

scepter_loc.en: Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.
scepter_loc.zh: 变形增加多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）。开启后会产生目标英雄的强幻象，可以施放英雄的所有基础技能。如果变体精灵切换变形时幻象还存活，他就会摧毁该幻象，并取而代之。

subject: phantom_lancer_juxtapose
definition: 制造自身或他人的幻象
evidence: 使幻影长矛手进入隐身，最多持续%invis_duration%秒，同时产生一个复制幻象来迷惑敌人。

context.description_en: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for %illusion_duration% seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last %illusion_from_illusion_duration% seconds.
context.description_zh: 幻影长矛手的攻击有一定几率使自己的存在破碎，产生自身的幻象。幻象也有几率进一步破碎，再产生幻象。幻影长矛手产生的幻象持续%illusion_duration%秒，幻象产生的幻象则持续%illusion_from_illusion_duration%秒。

shard_loc.en: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to %invis_duration% seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by %invis_movespeed%%% during this invisibility.
shard_loc.zh: 并列增加主动技能。使幻影长矛手进入隐身，最多持续%invis_duration%秒，同时产生一个复制幻象来迷惑敌人。隐身期间自身移动速度提升%invis_movespeed%%%。

幻影长矛手产生的幻象持续%illusion_duration%秒，幻象产生的幻象则持续%illusion_from_illusion_duration%秒。
幻影长矛手的攻击有一定几率使自己的存在破碎，产生自身的幻象。
Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself.
Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for %illusion_duration% seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last %illusion_from_illusion_duration% seconds.

Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for %illusion_duration% seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last %illusion_from_illusion_duration% seconds.

subject: phantom_lancer_phantom_edge
definition: 制造自身或他人的幻象
evidence: 另外，每冲锋%illusion_spawn_travel_distance%距离还会在幻影长矛手身旁制造一个并列幻象，向目标冲去。
每当幻影长矛手冲锋时穿过敌人，他就会制造并列幻象攻击他们。
Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them.
Additionally, every %illusion_spawn_travel_distance% units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.

context.description_en: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
context.description_zh: 对目标发动攻击后，幻影长矛手将快速向其冲去，获得移动速度和闪避提升。
notes_en: If the attack order is cancelled, the movement speed bonus is lost.
Rush movement speed is %bonus_speed%.
notes_zh: 如果冲锋中途取消攻击指令，那么移动速度加成就会消失。
冲锋过程中移动速度为%bonus_speed%。

scepter_loc.en: Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every %illusion_spawn_travel_distance% units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升距离。每当幻影长矛手冲锋时穿过敌人，他就会制造并列幻象攻击他们。另外，每冲锋%illusion_spawn_travel_distance%距离还会在幻影长矛手身旁制造一个并列幻象，向目标冲去。

subject: shadow_demon_disruption
definition: 制造自身或他人的幻象
evidence: 回归时会产生该单位的2个具有额外基础攻击力的幻象，受暗影恶魔控制。

context.description_en: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration.  Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.
context.description_zh: 将目标单位从战场上放逐一段时间。回归时会产生该单位的2个具有额外基础攻击力的幻象，受暗影恶魔控制。

subject: arc_warden_tempest_double
definition: 使自身或队友隐身（可被真视识破）
definition_note: U40：工程师·感应地雷不算隐身，另记事实备注
evidence: 风暴双雄产生时带有奥术、隐身和极速神符的效果，持续%rune_duration%秒。
The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.

context.description_en: Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.
context.description_zh: 天穹守望者将破碎的自我汇聚到一起，创造出自身的完美电子复制体。复制体可以使用天穹守望者的当前所有物品和基础技能，但是大部分消耗品以及死亡时会掉落的物品除外。复制体的物品和技能冷却时间会独立计算。复制体会逐渐失去自我意识，移动速度变慢，攻击准确度下降。
notes_en: Tempest Double and Refresher Orb cannot be used by the duplicate.
notes_zh: 复制体无法使用风暴双雄或刷新球。

shard_loc.en: The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.Does not trigger Runic Infusion.
shard_loc.zh: 风暴双雄产生时带有奥术、隐身和极速神符的效果，持续%rune_duration%秒。不会触发神符灌注。

subject: bounty_hunter_wind_walk
definition: 使自身或队友隐身（可被真视识破）
definition_note: U40：工程师·感应地雷不算隐身，另记事实备注
evidence: If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
赏金猎人进入隐身，获得移动速度加成，并能够穿越其它单位，直到他攻击或使用技能。
Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell.

context.description_en: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell.  If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
context.description_zh: 赏金猎人进入隐身，获得移动速度加成，并能够穿越其它单位，直到他攻击或使用技能。破隐一击会短暂眩晕目标。
notes_en: Will not break most channeling of spells upon activation.
notes_zh: 开启后不会打断大多数持续施法技能。

subject: broodmother_sticky_snare
definition: 使自身或队友隐身（可被真视识破）
definition_note: U40：工程师·感应地雷不算隐身，另记事实备注
evidence: Broodmother may create up to %count% invisible web lines touching any existing web.

context.description_en: Broodmother may create up to %count% invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time.  Multiple Heroes can trip on the same line until it's destroyed after being initially triggered.  Broodmother's team is alerted via the minimap when an enemy has triggered the snare.
context.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛可以制造出最多%count%个触碰已有蛛网的隐形网线。敌方英雄穿过网线将会触发陷阱，被缠绕，在战争迷雾中显形，并持续受到伤害。网线一开始被触发后，多名英雄还可以在同根网线上被绊倒，直到网线被摧毁。只要有人触发陷阱，育母蜘蛛的队友就会在小地图上发现。

subject: glimmer_cape
definition: 使自身或队友隐身（可被真视识破）
definition_note: U40：工程师·感应地雷不算隐身，另记事实备注
evidence: 5 second delay, grants invisibility, 20 movement speed and a magic damage barrier that absorbs up to 375 damage to you or a target allied unit for 5 seconds.

abilities.title: Glimmer
abilities.description:
After a 0.5 second delay, grants invisibility, 20 movement speed and a magic damage barrier that absorbs up to 375 damage to you or a target allied unit for 5 seconds.

Can be cast while channeling.

subject: hoodwink_decoy
definition: 使自身或队友隐身（可被真视识破）
definition_note: U40：工程师·感应地雷不算隐身，另记事实备注
evidence: 森海飞霞变为隐身，提升移动速度，并且产生一个引诱敌人的幻象，幻象会瞄准最近的敌方英雄开始蓄力准备发射伤害较低的一箭穿心。
Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero.

context.description_en: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.
context.description_zh: 森海飞霞变为隐身，提升移动速度，并且产生一个引诱敌人的幻象，幻象会瞄准最近的敌方英雄开始蓄力准备发射伤害较低的一箭穿心。如果幻象被攻击或被指向性技能击中，幻象将被摧毁并且攻击者将受到较弱的野地奇袭效果。

subject: invis_sword
definition: 使自身或队友隐身（可被真视识破）
definition_note: U40：工程师·感应地雷不算隐身，另记事实备注
evidence: If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain 175 bonus physical damage on that attack.
Makes you invisible for 17 seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell.

abilities.title: Shadow Walk
abilities.description:
Makes you invisible for 17 seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell. While Shadow Walk is active, you move 20% faster and can move through units. 

If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain 175 bonus physical damage on that attack.

context.notes:
Has a 0.3 second fade time.
If the invisibility ends without attacking, the bonus damage is lost.

subject: invoker_ghost_walk
definition: 使自身或队友隐身（可被真视识破）
definition_note: U40：工程师·感应地雷不算隐身，另记事实备注
evidence: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen.

game_file_fields.AbilityBehavior: DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IMMEDIATE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_HIDDEN | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NOT_LEARNABLE | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_CHANNEL | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_SHOW_IN_GUIDES | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_DIRECT_KEYBIND

context.description_en: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of Wex.
context.description_zh: 祈求者操纵冰电之力围绕自身，使自己隐形并且获得生命和魔法恢复。各种元素的不平衡导致附近敌人的移动速度被减缓，减速效果取决于冰元素的等级，并使祈求者自身移动速度减缓，减速效果与雷元素等级成反比。
notes_en: The slow effect does not work on Spell Immune enemies.
notes_zh: 减速效果对减益免疫状态下的单位无效。

shard_loc.en: Ghost Walk now also applies the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemy heroes in its area of effect.
shard_loc.zh: 现在幽灵漫步还会对范围内的敌方英雄施加寒冰之墙的每秒伤害。

subject: kez_ravens_veil

evidence: 凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和隐身状态，直到他攻击或施法。
Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.

context.description_en: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.
context.description_zh: 凯释放出一阵迷烟，对附近敌方英雄施加标记，暂时削弱他们的视野。凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和隐身状态，直到他攻击或施法。

subject: lycan_summon_wolves
definition: 使自身或队友隐身（可被真视识破）
definition_note: U40：工程师·感应地雷不算隐身，另记事实备注
evidence: 3级精灵狼获得永久隐身，4级精灵狼获得致残技能，20%几率使目标残废，造成每秒8点伤害，并失去60攻击速度，持续4秒。
At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.

context.description_en: Summons %wolf_count% wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
context.description_zh: 召唤%wolf_count%头精灵狼为狼人战斗。3级精灵狼获得永久隐身，4级精灵狼获得致残技能，20%几率使目标残废，造成每秒8点伤害，并失去60攻击速度，持续4秒。
notes_en: Using this spell will replace currently active summoned Wolves.
notes_zh: 使用此技能后原来的狼群将会死亡。

shard_loc.en: Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.
shard_loc.zh: 召唤的精灵狼的数量提升。所有召唤的精灵狼获得健步如飞技能，这个主动技能使精灵狼获得相位移动，闪避，移动速度和攻击速度。

subject: mirana_invis
definition: 使自身或队友隐身（可被真视识破）
definition_note: U40：工程师·感应地雷不算隐身，另记事实备注
evidence: 让米拉娜和所有己方英雄进入隐身状态。
Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed.
只要还在月光阴影的持续时间内，即使隐身被打破也会在短时间内重新淡入隐身。

context.description_en: Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed. Mirana gains bonus outgoing damage during the duration. If a hero is revealed, invisibility will restore after the fade delay as long as Moonlight Shadow's duration has not expired.
context.description_zh: 让米拉娜和所有己方英雄进入隐身状态。米拉娜在持续时间内获得伤害输出加成。只要还在月光阴影的持续时间内，即使隐身被打破也会在短时间内重新淡入隐身。
notes_en: Units affected will not auto attack enemies.
notes_zh: 受到作用的单位会自动停止攻击敌人。

subject: nyx_assassin_vendetta
definition: 使自身或队友隐身（可被真视识破）
definition_note: U40：工程师·感应地雷不算隐身，另记事实备注
evidence: 如果司夜刺客以攻击打破隐身，当次攻击将造成超高额外伤害，并对目标施加破坏效果。
If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target.
If a spell is used to break the invisibility, or the invisibility expires, the bonus damage is lost.
司夜刺客进入隐身状态并获得移动速度加成。
如果在隐身期间使用了技能，或者隐身时间结束，额外伤害的效果将会消失。
Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus.

context.description_en: Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has %attack_range_bonus% additional attack range and a %attack_animation_bonus%%% faster attack animation for this attack.
context.description_zh: 司夜刺客进入隐身状态并获得移动速度加成。如果司夜刺客以攻击打破隐身，当次攻击将造成超高额外伤害，并对目标施加破坏效果。司夜刺客当次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且攻击动作加快%attack_animation_bonus%%%。
notes_en: If a spell is used to break the invisibility, or the invisibility expires, the bonus damage is lost.
With Aghanim's Shard, the Break is applied before the bonus damage.

abilities.description:
Turns the caster and all allied player-controlled targets in a 1200 radius invisible, and grants 15% bonus movement speed for 45 seconds. 

 While the caster is still disguised, any allies that come within 300 range of them will also get the buff applied to them. Each smoke can only be applied once to allies.

context.description_en: Templar Assassin places mystical traps that invisibly monitor enemy movement. When sprung at her command, they exert a slowing influence of %movement_speed_min%%% in a %trap_radius% radius. Trap movement slow charges up to %movement_speed_max%%% after %trap_max_charge_duration% seconds. Deals damage after %trap_max_charge_duration%s.
context.description_zh: 圣堂刺客放下一个隐形的神秘陷阱监视敌人的动向。引爆后将减缓%trap_radius%范围内敌人的移动速度，陷阱放置时间越久，引爆后减速效果越强，最低为%movement_speed_min%%%，放置%trap_max_charge_duration%秒后引爆将达到最大减速效果，为%movement_speed_max%%%，并且还能造成额外伤害。
notes_en: Traps last indefinitely.
They have invisibility that fades in over %trap_fade_time% seconds and spell immunity. They take 2 hits to kill by ranged heroes, 1 by melee heroes, and 4 by creeps.
Traps have 250/250 vision range and don't prevent neutral camps from spawning.
notes_zh: 陷阱没有时间限制。
他们拥有隐形效果，渐隐时间为%trap_fade_time%秒，还拥有技能免疫状态。他们可以承受2次远程英雄的攻击，1次近战英雄的攻击，或4次非英雄单位的攻击。
陷阱的视野是250/250，不能阻止中立生物刷新。

scepter_loc.zh: 现在陷阱引爆后还会沉默受到作用的敌人。
